messages.content: Write the product page copy for a team chat application, aimed at engineering managers who are choosing between tools. Around 250 words.

**Nudge — team chat for people who ship**

Your engineers don't need one more place to be interrupted.

Nudge routes by ownership, not by channel. Connect a repo, a service, or a pager rotation, and every event that fires — failed deploy, review sitting two days, alert that keeps flapping — lands with whoever owns it. Nobody else's afternoon gets touched.

Threads finish. Whoever opened one can close it, and closed threads drop out of the sidebar. No digging on Monday to figure out whether Friday's incident ever got resolved.

Search reaches messages and any code you've linked, in one index, scoped to what each person is cleared to see. Legal doesn't need a separate tool for it.

Migration: import from Slack or Teams preserves channel history, timestamps, and thread structure.

Admin: SAML and SCIM on every paid plan, not held back for the enterprise tier. Retention configured per channel. Full export in JSON, yours on request, no support ticket in between.

Pricing is per active user per month. Deactivate someone and the billing stops that day.

Two things Nudge won't do: it isn't a project tracker, and it has no video. You already chose those. We integrate with what you chose.

Start with one team. Leave your current tool running beside it. Most people do that for about a month, then stop.

---

Still open before this ships: **Nudge** is a placeholder name. I cut the invented "200-person move runs over a weekend" line rather than replace it — drop in a real migration figure if you have one.
